title: Secured transaction priorities — Atlas Fabrication
instructions: Atlas Fabrication has defaulted. For each pair, select the party with priority in the collateral.

rows.label: First: Bank A, which filed a financing statement January 10. Second: Bank B, whose interest attached January 5 but which filed February 1.
rows.explanation: Priority goes to the first to file or perfect.

rows.label: First: a lender with an earlier-perfected blanket lien on equipment. Second: a seller with a PMSI in new equipment, perfected within 20 days after Atlas received it.
rows.explanation: A properly perfected PMSI in equipment has priority over earlier liens.

rows.label: First: a lender with a perfected interest in Atlas's inventory. Second: a buyer in the ordinary course who bought inventory from Atlas.
rows.explanation: Buyers in the ordinary course take free of security interests created by the seller.

rows.label: First: a creditor with an unperfected security interest. Second: Atlas's bankruptcy trustee.
rows.explanation: The trustee has lien creditor status over unperfected interests.

rows.label: First: a retailer with an unfiled PMSI in a consumer's TV. Second: the consumer's neighbor who bought the TV for home use without knowledge.
rows.explanation: A consumer buyer without knowledge takes free of an unfiled consumer-goods PMSI.
